activity.overview: Use hundred grids and money to connect tenths, hundredths and decimals.

problems.prompt: On a hundred grid, shade 3 full columns of 10 squares. What fraction of the grid is shaded in tenths? In hundredths?
Add: 4/10 + 25/100. Change the tenths to hundredths first.
Write 0.8 as a fraction with a denominator of 10 and as a fraction with a denominator of 100.
A dime is 1/10 of a dollar and a penny is 1/100 of a dollar. Write 3 dimes and 4 pennies as a fraction of a dollar and as a decimal.
Write two and seven hundredths as a decimal.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Tenths and Hundredths
